integrity: The classification follows directly from the published survival function. Interior injectivity is proved by asymptotic recovery of the exponential-power term followed by exact subtraction; boundary equivalence classes are obtained by direct substitution. Numerical replay is used only as a consistency check.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns exact structural identifiability, not estimation rates or Fisher-information behavior near zero scales.
Positive-interior numerical fits in the source are not invalidated because its Bayesian section uses strictly positive parameters.
An older general additive-hazard identifiability theorem could encode a related boundary principle under more abstract notation.
title: Exact boundary identifiability stratification of the FEPW model
